notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Lowglow gets some updates that the community has been asking for.

There is now a text under each level indicating if you have passed under the maximum line limit! Unfortunately this feature cannot see if you have done this already but will track it from now on! 
Thank you for the suggestion @Inspiral

There are also some corrections made to the story and bug fixes.

- Miika
Game Designer
